text:
maria: Heads-up — opening a tiny TF change for prod VPC egress failover. Goal: prefer local AZ NAT, fall back cross-AZ NAT, and only if those fail route specific traffic to endpoints (S3 via gateway, third-party via interface PrivateLink). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/512
ryan: Quick q — how will you implement the failover ordering? AWS routes don't have priority, longest-prefix wins. Want to avoid blackholing during flips.
samir: Can you paste the TF snippet you're proposing? Also we should check EIP pool sizes before we create more NATs.
maria: snippet below — simple route resource per AZ, route_table per subnet. Plan is for an autoscaling hook to replace the default route when local NAT becomes unhealthy:
```hcl
resource "aws_route" "default_egress" {
  route_table_id         = aws_route_table.az_rt[count.index].id
  destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
  nat_gateway_id         = aws_nat_gateway.local[count.index].id
}
```
lina: make sure the PrivateLink endpoints are interface endpoints with ENIs in each AZ if you expect cross-AZ fallback to hit them. security group on the endpoint needs 443 from our subnets.
ryan: Another pattern: use separate per-AZ route tables where the default points to local NAT. For failover you update that AZ's route table to point to cross-AZ NAT. That keeps changes scoped. Will the autoscaler run a TF apply or an orchestration job?
maria: intended flow: TF creates the resources and a small controller (k8s job) monitors NAT health (CloudWatch metric) and updates route table via API (not terraform) to avoid churn. TF still owns the resource definitions.
samir: heads up — that means we should add lifecycle.ignore_changes on the route resources in TF, otherwise CI will flip them back. Also add an EIP pool sizing doc in PR.
maria: good call, adding lifecycle. also adding a short note about EIP pool sizing (we've had exhaustion on bursty batch jobs).
ryan: nit: add `prevent_destroy = true` on the NAT resources and a warning in the runbook about failback timing.
ci-bot: CI: terraform plan OK — no changes to infra (plan: noop) :white_check_mark:
lina: one more thing — for S3 prefer gateway endpoint (cheaper, no ENI) and only use interface endpoints for external vendor APIs that need privatelink. Also add SG egress rules to allow 443 to endpoint ENIs.
maria: great — switching S3 to gateway endpoint and keeping PrivateLink for vendors. will update the PR and the runbook. thanks all!
